lines: HCD's Notice of Funding Availability Calendar (PDF) shows targeted release dates for draft guidelines, NOFAs, and awards. It also lists NOFA application due dates — Last updated 8/2024
You can view NOFA documents on each individual Grants & Funding program webpage. View all Federal Active Programs and State Active Programs.
title: Notice of Funding Availability (NOFA) Calendar | California Department of Housing and Community Development
